_note: UHY-ASK's CSA Expert mapping, written on 23 November 2026 from the restored copy's schema and code tables (clients/uhy/ops/csa-schema.sql and csa-profile.sql). Each query returns exactly the column names the importer checks (src/integrations/csa/sql-source.ts). Only current private Hong Kong companies are read (JURISD HKG, COMTYP PVT, active, status OPE or DOR): the case list has no deadline rule yet for public, guarantee or registered non-Hong Kong companies. Position codes: 11D director, 13S company secretary, 14D alternate director, 01M member. Entity type C is a corporate body. Assumptions to confirm on the first cases, against CSA's own form: an individual's NAME_1 is the surname; REG_* is the total amount of issued share capital and PAID_* the amount paid up; a corporate secretary's registration number is the business registration number on its own client record in CSA, or failing that its IDNUM (the secretary of 168 companies has no IDNUM but is itself a client); DOCLANG 1 means Chinese; a blank class description on an ordinary class means Ordinary. Where CSA has no English name for a person, the name printed on its forms or the Chinese name is used. CSA's e-filing login and password columns are never read. Checked against the copy on 23 November: 192 companies, 639 officers, 291 members, 198 share classes, 13 contacts with an email; members' shares add up to the issued shares in 196 of 198 classes; NAME_1 is the surname (in capitals for 3,731 of 4,842 individuals).
companies: SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CLIENTID)) AS csaId, LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CLIENTID)) AS code, LTRIM(RTRIM(c.NAME_1 + ' ' + ISNULL(c.NAME_2, ''))) AS nameEn, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.NAME_C)), '') AS nameZh, b.BUSREGNO AS brNumber, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.COMNUM)), '') AS companyNumber, CONVERT(char(10), c.INCDATE, 23) AS incorporatedOn, NULL AS registeredOn, CASE WHEN c.AC_DDMM LIKE '[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9]' THEN CAST(RIGHT(c.AC_DDMM, 2) AS int) END AS fyeMonth, CASE WHEN c.AC_DDMM LIKE '[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9]' THEN CAST(LEFT(c.AC_DDMM, 2) AS int) END AS fyeDay, STUFF('' + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.REGADD_1E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.REGADD_2E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.REGADD_3E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.REGADD_4E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.REGADD_CE)), ''), ''), 1, 2, '') AS registeredOffice, 'private' AS companyType FROM CLIENT c OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 r.BUSREGNO FROM BUSREG r WHERE r.CLIENTID = c.CLIENTID AND r.BRTYPE = 'COR' AND r.TILLDATE IS NULL AND r.BUSREGNO LIKE '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' ORDER BY r.ISRO DESC) b WHERE c.JURISD = 'HKG' AND c.COMTYP = 'PVT' AND c.ISACTIVE = 1 AND c.COMSTA IN ('OPE', 'DOR')
officers: SELECT m.CLIENTID + '|' + m.MTYPE + '|' + m.ENTITYID + '|' + m.TRUSTID + '|' + m.BRID AS csaId, LTRIM(RTRIM(m.CLIENTID)) AS companyCsaId, CASE m.MTYPE WHEN '13S' THEN 'secretary' WHEN '14D' THEN 'alternate' ELSE 'director' END AS role, CASE WHEN e.TYPE = 'C' THEN 'corporate' ELSE 'individual' END AS kind, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN e.TYPE = 'C' THEN ISNULL(e.NAME_1, '') ELSE UPPER(ISNULL(e.NAME_1, '')) END + ' ' + ISNULL(e.NAME_2, ''))), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.FORMNAME)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(e.NAME_1C, '') + ISNULL(e.NAME_2C, ''))), ''), 'Name not recorded in CSA') AS nameEn, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(e.NAME_1C, '') + ISNULL(e.NAME_2C, ''))), '') AS nameZh, COALESCE(STUFF('' + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.STAADD_1E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.STAADD_2E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.STAADD_3E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.STAADD_4E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.STAADD_CE)), ''), ''), 1, 2, ''), STUFF('' + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.REGADD_1E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.REGADD_2E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.REGADD_3E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.REGADD_4E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.REGADD_CE)), ''), ''), 1, 2, '')) AS correspondenceAddress, NULL AS email, CASE WHEN e.TYPE = 'C' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.IDNUM)), '') END AS idNumber, CASE WHEN e.TYPE = 'C' THEN COALESCE(sb.BUSREGNO, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.IDNUM)), '')) END AS brNumber, CASE WHEN e.TYPE = 'C' THEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.TCSPNO)), '') END AS tcspLicence, CONVERT(char(10), m.SINCEDATE, 23) AS appointedOn, NULL AS ceasedOn FROM MASTER m JOIN CLIENT c ON c.CLIENTID = m.CLIENTID OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 x.TYPE, x.NAME_1, x.NAME_2, x.FORMNAME, x.NAME_1C, x.NAME_2C, x.IDNUM, x.TCSPNO, x.CLIENTID AS OWNCLIENT, x.REGADD_1E, x.REGADD_2E, x.REGADD_3E, x.REGADD_4E, x.REGADD_CE FROM ENTITY x WHERE x.ENTITYID = m.ENTITYID ORDER BY CASE WHEN x.SNUM = m.SNUM THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, x.SNUM DESC) e OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 r.BUSREGNO FROM BUSREG r WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.OWNCLIENT)), '') IS NOT NULL AND r.CLIENTID = e.OWNCLIENT AND r.BRTYPE = 'COR' AND r.BUSREGNO LIKE '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.TILLDATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.ISRO DESC) sb WHERE m.MTYPE IN ('11D', '13S', '14D') AND m.TILLDATE IS NULL AND c.JURISD = 'HKG' AND c.COMTYP = 'PVT' AND c.ISACTIVE = 1 AND c.COMSTA IN ('OPE', 'DOR')
members: SELECT s.CLIENTID + '|' + s.ENTITYID + '|' + s.TRUSTID + '|' + CAST(s.CLASSID AS varchar(10)) + '|' + s.REGIST AS csaId, LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CLIENTID)) AS companyCsaId, CASE WHEN e.TYPE = 'C' THEN 'corporate' ELSE 'individual' END AS kind, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN e.TYPE = 'C' THEN ISNULL(e.NAME_1, '') ELSE UPPER(ISNULL(e.NAME_1, '')) END + ' ' + ISNULL(e.NAME_2, ''))), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.FORMNAME)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(e.NAME_1C, '') + ISNULL(e.NAME_2C, ''))), ''), 'Name not recorded in CSA') AS nameEn, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(e.NAME_1C, '') + ISNULL(e.NAME_2C, ''))), '') AS nameZh, STUFF('' + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.REGADD_1E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.REGADD_2E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.REGADD_3E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.REGADD_4E)), ''), '') + ISNULL(', ' + NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.REGADD_CE)), ''), ''), 1, 2, '') AS address, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(k.DES)), ''), CASE WHEN k.ISORDINARY = 1 THEN 'Ordinary' ELSE 'Unnamed class' END) AS className, s.SHARES AS shares FROM MEMSHA s JOIN CLIENT c ON c.CLIENTID = s.CLIENTID JOIN CLISHA k ON k.CLIENTID = s.CLIENTID AND k.CLASSID = s.CLASSID AND k.ISACTIVE = 1 OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 x.TYPE, x.NAME_1, x.NAME_2, x.FORMNAME, x.NAME_1C, x.NAME_2C, x.IDNUM, x.REGADD_1E, x.REGADD_2E, x.REGADD_3E, x.REGADD_4E, x.REGADD_CE FROM ENTITY x WHERE x.ENTITYID = s.ENTITYID ORDER BY x.SNUM DESC) e WHERE s.MTYPE = '01M' AND s.SHARES > 0 AND c.JURISD = 'HKG' AND c.COMTYP = 'PVT' AND c.ISACTIVE = 1 AND c.COMSTA IN ('OPE', 'DOR')
shareClasses: SELECT k.CLIENTID + '|' + CAST(k.CLASSID AS varchar(10)) AS csaId, LTRIM(RTRIM(k.CLIENTID)) AS companyCsaId, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(k.DES)), ''), CASE WHEN k.ISORDINARY = 1 THEN 'Ordinary' ELSE 'Unnamed class' END) AS className, CASE WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(k.CURRCODE, ''))) IN ('', 'HK$') THEN 'HKD' ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(k.CURRCODE)) END AS currency, ISNULL(k.ISHARES, 0) AS issuedShares, ISNULL(k.REG_CASH, 0) + ISNULL(k.REG_ASSET, 0) + ISNULL(k.REG_INT, 0) AS totalAmount, ISNULL(k.PAID_CASH, 0) + ISNULL(k.PAID_ASSET, 0) + ISNULL(k.PAID_INT, 0) AS paidUp FROM CLISHA k JOIN CLIENT c ON c.CLIENTID = k.CLIENTID WHERE k.ISACTIVE = 1 AND k.ISHARES > 0 AND c.JURISD = 'HKG' AND c.COMTYP = 'PVT' AND c.ISACTIVE = 1 AND c.COMSTA IN ('OPE', 'DOR')
contacts: SELECT k.CLIENTID + '|' + CAST(k.CONIDX AS varchar(10)) AS csaId, LTRIM(RTRIM(k.CLIENTID)) AS companyCsaId, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(k.CONTACT)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(k.BEHALF)), ''), LTRIM(RTRIM(k.EMAIL))) AS name, LTRIM(RTRIM(k.EMAIL)) AS email, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(k.TEL)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(k.MOBILE)), '')) AS phone, CASE WHEN k.DOCLANG = 1 THEN 'tc' ELSE 'en' END AS language FROM CLICON k JOIN CLIENT c ON c.CLIENTID = k.CLIENTID WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(k.EMAIL)), '') IS NOT NULL AND c.JURISD = 'HKG' AND c.COMTYP = 'PVT' AND c.ISACTIVE = 1 AND c.COMSTA IN ('OPE', 'DOR')
